# CI and Release Requirements Checklist: Feature 002

**Purpose**: Review whether Feature 002 requirements are complete, measurable, and internally consistent for GitHub-hosted validation and deck distribution
**Created**: 2026-10-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are pull requests and pushes to `main` both identified as CI triggers, with no unintended release trigger for ordinary pushes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the supported Python environment and dependency installation requirements stated for both normal CI and tagged releases? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK003 Are vocabulary and media validation, the full test suite, Ruff lint, Ruff formatting, and deck generation all required gates in both flows? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 Is reuse of the documented local validation and build commands required clearly enough to rule out copied application rules in workflow configuration? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Are a run artifact for maintainer inspection and a GitHub Release asset for learners specified as distinct outputs with different purposes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-009, §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the CI artifact's name, availability period, and any required retention duration specified or deliberately left to the hosting default? [Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the exact learner-facing Release filename `indonesian-malaysian.apkg` required while the existing local output remains `dist/myid-anki.apkg`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the relationship among local output, CI artifact contents, and renamed Release asset explicit enough to prevent publishing the wrong file? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK009 Are contributor, maintainer, and learner README obligations individually specified, including where each finds the relevant output? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK010 Are Feature 002 exclusions explicit enough to prevent AnkiWeb publishing, scheduled releases, Docker, extra distribution services, or automatic content acquisition from entering scope? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]

## Trigger and Provenance Clarity

- [ ] CHK011 Is the accepted release-tag grammar precise enough to distinguish `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` from nonmatching tags and broader `v*.*.*` glob matches? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the spec state whether only a pushed matching tag can initiate learner-facing publication, excluding normal main pushes and unrelated manual runs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the tagged commit, rather than the current main branch or a previous CI run, unambiguously required as the source of release validation and build? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the chain from checked tagged revision to published package specific enough to rule out an unrelated artifact or a fresh build from another commit? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009, §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements for rerunning publication on an existing tag clear about which asset is replaced and how duplicate deck assets are avoided? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §Edge Cases]

## Failure and Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Does every required quality gate have an unambiguous failure outcome for CI and for a tagged release? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, §FR-008, §User Story 1, §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK017 Do release failure requirements prevent a new or replacement learner asset when validation, tests, lint, formatting, or deck generation fails? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK018 Are vocabulary and media validation failures distinguished from later package-generation failures without allowing either to produce a successful run? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the header-only vocabulary case specified as a failing prerequisite without permitting invented or placeholder concepts to make CI green? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 Are missing `.apkg` output and attempted artifact-upload failure covered so CI cannot silently pass without a usable artifact? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the expected outcome for a publication failure after release creation or update specified clearly enough to avoid claiming a successful downloadable deck? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK022 Are nonmatching and malformed version tags covered with an explicit no-publication outcome? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, §Edge Cases]

## Security and Identity Consistency

- [ ] CHK023 Are normal CI permissions constrained to read-only access, including pull-request checks? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK024 Is release-write permission limited to the publication job rather than granted to the entire release workflow or its build job? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK025 Is use of built-in GitHub authentication specified, with a new repository secret excluded unless technically necessary? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK026 Are permissions and publication requirements consistent with the need to read the tagged source while writing only the Release? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK027 Does the spec explicitly make Git tag/version text independent of concept IDs, note GUID derivation, deck ID, and note-model ID? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK028 Are identity-preservation criteria measurable across two differently tagged releases with unchanged concept IDs? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK029 Are update-import expectations aligned with supported Anki behavior without implying that omitted notes are automatically deleted? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 3, §Edge Cases, §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK030 Are hosted CI acceptance criteria defined for a successful pull request or main run and a downloadable inspection artifact, beyond static workflow review? [Coverage, Spec §SC-001, §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK031 Are hosted release acceptance criteria defined for pushing a test version tag, observing the corresponding Release, and downloading its asset? [Coverage, Spec §SC-002, §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK032 Is importability of the downloaded `indonesian-malaysian.apkg` in Anki an explicit acceptance outcome rather than an assumed consequence of the extension? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010, §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK033 Are acceptance criteria strong enough to detect a Release asset built from a different revision than the tag? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK034 Do measurable success criteria cover failed gate publication, no release on ordinary main pushes, rerun replacement, and unchanged Anki identities? [Coverage, Spec §SC-003, §SC-004, §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK035 Are manual acceptance prerequisites, including a reviewed nonempty vocabulary dataset and suitable GitHub repository settings, explicit enough to prevent a header-only source failure being misclassified as workflow failure? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK036 Are the README success criteria objectively reviewable for contributor artifact discovery, maintainer release creation, learner download, and update import? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, §FR-016]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Add findings inline with references to the spec or plan. This checklist does not indicate implementation completion.
